name: @home/homecore-client
description: The one piece every Tier 1 app that has no identity of its own (HomeMedia, HomeSync, HomeNotes, and — once split, see MIGRATION_PLAN.md — HomeCloud) genuinely shares: verifying a request's token by asking HomeCore, and the Express middleware that wraps that check. Extracted from three near-identical copies of the same ~40 lines — see CHANGELOG.md for the extraction.
